title: [GDExtension] Godot does not find what target library is dynamically loaded due to `LoadLibraryExW`.
body:
### Tested versions

- Godot Engine v4.7.dev.custom_build.d95bb0925 (2026-04-10 11:36:05 UTC) - https://godotengine.org
- v4.6 stable (from steam)

### System information

Windows 11 Home (25H2) x86_64 | 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1260P (16) @ 4.7 GHz | Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (128.00 MiB) [Integrated]

### Issue description

Godot successfully loads the dynamic library itself, but not additional dynamic libraries it depends on on Windows.  
Shipping the dynamic libraries did not fix my problem.

[Specifying no operation on `LoadLibraryEx`](https://github.com/Lemno-Studio/godot/commit/0d4ccb06d9675caf3e2e5f25ffabff0cc79cb934) has fixed this specific problem on windows, [platform/windows/os_windows.cpp:523]

Hence I want to know the exact reason to specify the behaviour with `LoadLibraryEx` to understand the problem better.
I would like to change `LoadLibraryExW` to `LoadLibraryW` if there is any good reason.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Make a shared object(or .dll) as valid gdextension form which depends on at least `libc++`.  
2. Make a valid gdextension file which points to shared object we've made.
3. Ships the shared objects(library) the shared object depends to
4. Try opening it with godot
